# Raw Status — verify drift detection for raw files

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- Clean state: no drift ---
exec akb raw status
stdout 'no drift'

# --- Write a raw file, then check status (still no drift) ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write data.csv
exec akb raw status
stdout 'no drift'

# --- Modified file: change file on disk, detect drift ---
# Overwrite the file directly (bypassing akb) to change its hash
cp ../modified-input.txt raw/data.csv
! exec akb raw status
stdout 'MODIFIED data.csv'
! stdout 'UNTRACKED'
! stdout 'MISSING'

# --- Modified file exits with code 1 ---
! exec akb raw status

# --- Untracked file: create file directly in raw/ ---
cp ../data-input.txt raw/untracked.txt
! exec akb raw status
stdout 'UNTRACKED untracked.txt'

# --- Missing file: delete a tracked file from disk ---
rm raw/data.csv
! exec akb raw status
stdout 'MISSING data.csv'

# --- Specific file check: filter to one file ---
# Restore data.csv with modified content so it's MODIFIED
cp ../modified-input.txt raw/data.csv
! exec akb raw status data.csv
stdout 'MODIFIED data.csv'
! stdout 'untracked.txt'

# --- Specific file with no drift exits 0 ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write fresh.csv
exec akb raw status fresh.csv
stdout 'no drift'

# --- JSON output format ---
! exec akb raw status --json
stdout '"files"'
stdout '"summary"'
stdout '"modified"'
stdout '"untracked"'
stdout '"missing"'

# --- JSON output with no drift ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write clean.csv
exec akb raw status clean.csv --json
stdout '"modified": 0'
stdout '"untracked": 0'
stdout '"missing": 0'

# --- Error: no raw/ directory ---
rm -rf raw
! exec akb raw status
stderr 'raw/ directory not found'

# --- Error: corrupted manifest ---
exec akb init test-kb2
cd test-kb2
stdin ../../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write data.csv
# Corrupt the manifest by overwriting with invalid content
cp ../../corrupt-manifest.txt raw/files.log
! exec akb raw status
stderr 'corrupted'

-- csv-input.txt --
hello

-- modified-input.txt --
modified content

-- data-input.txt --
data

-- corrupt-manifest.txt --
invalid line without pipes
